title.en: Supplication upon entering the home, full greeting

recitation.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَا تُهُ

translation.id: Semoga keselamatan, rahmat dan keberkahan terlimpah untukmu.
translation.en: May peace, Allah's mercy, and His blessings be upon you.

body.id: Rujukan warisan: HR. at-Tirmidzi. Catatan ini belum diverifikasi dan bukan sumber terstruktur.
body.en: Legacy citation: HR. at-Tirmidzi. This note is unverified and is not a structured source reference.

benefits.id: Salam adalah doa pengharapan, pengharapan agar Anda selamat dari segala macam duka dan derita, serta diliputi rahmat dan keberkahan.
benefits.en: The greeting of peace is a prayer that others be safe from sorrow and suffering and be surrounded by mercy and blessing.
